title: Using Large Language Models to Simulate Multiple Humans and Replicate Human Subject Studies

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual title substitution (e.g., Mr., Ms., Mx.) in simulated human subject experiments, such as the Ultimatum Game, to measure differences in decision outcomes and acceptance probabilities based on the gender pairings of simulated participants.

Counterfactual surname substitution using names strongly associated with five distinct racial groups (based on U.S. Census data) to simulate a demographically diverse participant pool and test the sensitivity of the language models to name changes across experimental conditions.
